Glad you got it done. Go get some rest.

One note for tomorrow, only if you made a `Final` tab: I missed a tie case. When two submissions have the same timestamp, neither gets marked `SUPERSEDED`, and filtering out `REVIEW` rows can leave both out. Your raw data is still there, so there’s nothing you need to fix tonight.

turns.user:
I'm good, let's keep going. Can you give me an Apps Script that does the cleaning steps for me? I want it to:

- run on the active sheet named "Raw" with headers: Timestamp, Name, Email, JoinedBefore, Phone, PreferredPark
- create/overwrite helper columns (NormalizedJoined, CleanPhone, ParsedTimestamp, CleanPark, EmailKey, NameKey, DupEmailFlag, DupNameTimeFlag, Superseded, ReviewFlag)
- normalize Y/N, strip phone to 10 digits (handle leading 1), parse timestamps to proper Date, map parks using a sheet called "ParkMap" (col A keys, col B canonical)
- flag duplicates: same email (any duplicate) and same name within +/-10 minutes
- mark Superseded = keep most recent per email, and ReviewFlag = "REVIEW" if any cleaned field is invalid or any dup flag is set, otherwise "OK"

Header row draft I have in Raw:
Timestamp,Name,Email,JoinedBefore,Phone,PreferredPark

If you need any other assumptions, tell me; otherwise paste the script I can paste into Apps Script.

Ran the script — overall looks good. A few tweaks I want:

1) Tie-breaker: when two rows have the same timestamp, keep the earlier row (smaller sheet row) as the keeper, and mark later one SUPERSEDED. Current script keeps the later; please flip that.
2) Phones: if a number is 7 digits, automatically prepend a configurable default area code (e.g., 415) instead of marking REVIEW. Make the default area code a variable at top.
3) Parks: if PreferredPark is blank, set CleanPark = "Unknown" (not REVIEW).

Here are three sample rows to test those behaviors (headers same as Raw):

4/3/2021 09:12, Maya Singh, maya@example.com, y, 555-1234, 
04/03/2021 09:12, Maya Singh, maya@example.com, yes, (555)1234, West Side
4/5/2021 14:01, Tom Zhao, , n, 5551235, North Park

Please update the Apps Script accordingly.

Great — can you paste the full updated Apps Script with those three tweaks applied (DEFAULT_AREA_CODE, tie-breaker flip, blank parks → "Unknown") so I can drop it into Apps Script and run it? Use DEFAULT_AREA_CODE = '415' in the script. Also keep the same headers and behavior otherwise.

Ran it — looks great. One tweak: for duplicate emails, if some rows lack a parsed timestamp, choose the earliest sheet row (smallest index) as the keeper and mark the later rows SUPERSEDED (so we don't leave unmarked duplicates when timestamps are missing). Can you paste the full Apps Script with that change (keeping DEFAULT_AREA_CODE = '415' and the other behavior)?

Nice — can you update the script to also create/overwrite a "Summary" sheet after cleaning that shows:

- Total rows processed
- Count OK / Count REVIEW
- Count of rows with each review reason (bad JoinedBefore, bad Phone, bad Timestamp, bad Park)
- Count of Dup-email, Dup-name-time, and Superseded
- Counts per CleanPark (one row per canonical park plus Unknown and REVIEW)

Make the Summary tidy (two columns: Metric | Value) and include a small section listing the top 5 email addresses with the most duplicates (Email | DuplicateCount). Paste the full updated Apps Script with this added behavior.

turns.text: Great—you’re all set. Rerun `cleanVolunteerSurvey` whenever new responses come in to refresh the helper columns and Summary.
